input: SC-LU-FRIEZA-001 — Lineup decode: Frieza, The Outsider's First Investment / Substrate Activation. Source draft SC-FR-001 (docs/SC-FR-001_THE_OUTSIDERS_FIRST_INVESTMENT.md) and SC-MIRROR-001 spec sections 4.4 and 6.1. Five layers kept together: black-hole origin domain outside the universe, owned by another entity, entered by stealth as an outside invasion (open hypothesis); ch. 87 time chamber outside this universe (canon), placed by Shax in the Duality's mirrored universe, time running in reverse (open hypothesis); Black Frieza (canon).

metadata.title: Lineup Decode: Frieza — The Outsider's First Investment / Substrate Activation

addenda.note: Shax ruling t568u (2026-11-25), RUL-BINARY-001: SC-DU-001 (The Duality) and SC-MD-001 (Sovereign Mirror Duality) are the same invariant: a binary whose only stable outcomes are mutual cooperation or mutual destruction. Instances: Oneness/Sovereignty (SC-CP-001), God/Satan (theological mapping), and our universe / the CPT-mirrored universe (SC-LU-FRIEZA-001 layer D). Hub: SC-MIRROR-001 CLM-MIRROR-006. Graded ISOMORPHIC_INVARIANT (structural equivalence claim by Shax); no physics or theology claim is upgraded and no score changes.

claims.label: CORE — OUTSIDER'S FIRST INVESTMENT
claims.text: An entity from an external substrate, upon its first localized temporal investment, produces output that breaks the established local hierarchy. Canon instance: after 10 years in the ch. 87 chamber, Black Frieza defeats Ultra Instinct Goku and Ultra Ego Vegeta, the two figures the local hierarchy was built around.
residuals: 'First investment' needs scoping: Frieza trained for four months to reach Golden Frieza (Resurrection 'F' / Dragon Ball Super). The ch. 87 chamber is his first long-duration investment, not his first training. The spec's 'pre-cost Frieza (zero training)' holds for Namek-era Frieza only.

claims.label: FIVE LAYERS (KEPT TOGETHER)
claims.text: Layers A–E are one claim and are kept together: (A) origin in a black-hole domain outside the familiar universe; (B) that domain is owned or controlled by another entity; (C) entry into this universe by stealth — an outside invasion; (D) the ch. 87 time chamber outside this universe (canon), which Shax places in the Duality's mirrored universe, time running in reverse (OPEN_HYPOTHESIS); (E) Black Frieza (canon). Layers A–C are not reduced to a hard-work metaphor; they are the cosmological content of the entry, held as OPEN_HYPOTHESIS, and layer D repeats their crossing of the universe boundary.

layers.name: External substrate
layers.text: Frieza's lineage originates from a pre-existing black-hole domain outside the familiar universe.

layers.name: External agency / ownership
layers.text: That black hole is owned or controlled by another entity.

layers.name: Concealed entry (outside invasion)
layers.text: The outside lineage entered this universe by stealth and deception, an outside invasion: an infiltration from outside, not an origin inside.

layers.name: Temporal refuge outside this universe
layers.text: Frieza left this universe and trained ten years in a time chamber in the Duality's mirrored universe, where time runs in reverse relative to ours. Canon fixes the chamber, the ten years, and Frieza's own statement that he was outside this universe; that the chamber lies in the CPT-mirror universe is Shax's interpretation (OPEN_HYPOTHESIS).

layers.name: Black Frieza
layers.text: Frieza returns, kills Gas, and defeats Ultra Instinct Goku and Ultra Ego Vegeta with one strike each.

canon.text: Frieza says that on one of the planets he conquered there was a room where time flows differently, like the Room of Spirit and Time, and that he gained ten years' worth of training there.

Asked how he beat Gas, who was wished to be the strongest in the universe, Frieza says it may be because he was in another dimension while he trained, outside this universe, so the wish did not count him. The 'outside this universe' part of layer D is in Frieza's own words, as his speculation.

canon.source: Dragon Ball Z; Dragon Ball Super (Galactic Patrol)
canon.text: Known chambers: the Lookout's gives one year per outside day, with a two-day limit per person in Dragon Ball Z; the Galactic Patrol's gives three days per outside day. No one else is shown training ten years in one stay.

secondary.text: The Room of Spirit and Time is a dimension outside Universe 7 reached through doorways; Frieza's chamber is read as a variant of it.
The outside time is commonly reported as about ten days. If so, the rate is 365:1, the same as the Lookout's; what is extreme is ten years in one stay, not the rate.

interpretation.text: Frieza left this universe and trained in another universe that held a more capable time-manipulating chamber than the Room of Spirit and Time. That universe is the Duality's mirrored universe: the CPT-mirror universe in which time runs in reverse relative to ours. The conquered planet holds the doorway; the chamber is on the mirror side.
interpretation.resolves: Open question 'which universe holds the chamber' (2026-11-25): Shax answers that it is the Duality's mirrored universe (t566u).
interpretation.support: Frieza's own words place him outside this universe while he trained (canon). The mirrored universe is a published cosmological model (physics_anchor), not a confirmed one.
interpretation.not_shown: Canon does not name the universe or say that time runs in reverse there. Identifying it with the CPT mirror is Shax's interpretation.

physics_anchor.citation: Latham Boyle, Kieran Finn and Neil Turok, 'CPT-Symmetric Universe', Phys. Rev. Lett. 121, 251301 (2018), doi:10.1103/PhysRevLett.121.251301. Companion: Robles-Pérez, Universe 5(6), 150 (2019).
physics_anchor.content: The universe before the Big Bang is modelled as the CPT image of the universe after it: a mirror universe in which time runs backward relative to ours. The model makes testable predictions; none is confirmed.
physics_anchor.use_here: Anchors the existence claim of a mirrored universe as a published model. It does not anchor Frieza's chamber being there.

structural_fit.text: A domain whose time runs in reverse relative to ours would account for an extreme time relation between the chamber and this universe: ten years inside while little time passes here.
residuals: In the Boyle–Finn–Turok model the mirror's time runs in the opposite direction from the Big Bang; that is a reversed arrow, not a different clock rate, so reverse time alone does not produce dilation.

In that model the mirror lies on the other side of the Big Bang, not alongside us; reaching it from a conquered planet needs the SC-HS-001 / SC-MIRROR-001 black-hole framing (CLM-HS-002B, CLM-MIRROR-005), which is OPEN_HYPOTHESIS.
If the commonly reported ten days outside is right, the rate equals the Lookout's 365:1; the extreme part is the duration of one stay.

ties.SC-DU-001: The Duality: one source split into two poles; this universe and its mirror are the two poles at cosmological scale.
ties.SC-MD-001 / SC-MIRROR-001: The CPT-symmetric universe anchor (SC-MD-001, compiled as SC-MIRROR-001) and the backup-snapshot hypothesis CLM-MIRROR-005: the chamber sits on the backup side of the mirror.
ties.SC-HS-001: CLM-HS-002B (black-hole interior / larger spacetime), OPEN_HYPOTHESIS: the horizon is the boundary the mirror sits behind.

binary_invariant.note: Shax ruling t568u: our universe and the mirrored universe are one instance of the Duality's binary (mutual cooperation or mutual destruction), the same invariant as Oneness/Sovereignty and God/Satan. Hub: SC-MIRROR-001 CLM-MIRROR-006. Structural claim; the physics stays PUBLISHED_MODEL (not confirmed) and the chamber placement stays OPEN_HYPOTHESIS.

layer_d_detail.tie_to_outsider_layers: D is the outsider pattern repeated: a lineage from a black-hole domain outside this universe (A), owned by another entity (B), that entered by stealth (C), goes back outside this universe, to the Duality's mirrored universe, to invest, and re-enters with output the local hierarchy cannot match (E). Shax places the chamber in the mirror; whether the mirror is also the origin domain (A) or the owner's domain (B) is not stated.

ownership_architectures.text: Domain as prison: the lineage escaped; a refugee from a collapsing substrate.
Domain as weapon: external 'fake gods' seed universes with invasive species.
Domain as different base weight / Clay (SC-CP-001): Frieza wasn't compiled here.

claims.label: SUBSTRATE ACTIVATION
claims.text: Substrate activation is proposed as a third power mechanism, distinct from binding vow (power through restriction) and deliberate investment (developing existing capacity): an architecture that was never trained meets its first compatible input, and the response is out of proportion to the size of the investment because the substrate itself was the reserve. Black Frieza is the instance.
claims.tension: SC-FR-001 DRAFT 0.1 files the 10-year training as deliberate investment, and the spec calls it Frieza's 'first binding vow' while also naming substrate activation as distinct from both. Reading used here: at the event level the input is a deliberate investment; what is claimed distinct is the response profile of an untrained alien substrate. Left for Shax to confirm.

claims.label: RESTRAINT REMOVAL
claims.text: Frieza's transformations remove limiters on power that is already there — the inverse of every other lineup character, who adds power by training, restriction or release of control. Structural reading: the external substrate arrives over-provisioned and throttled, not under-built.

claims.label: SPIRIT BOMB STRUCTURAL RESPONSE
claims.text: Frieza survives the Namek Spirit Bomb (canon) despite being deliberately evil, so the outcome is not moral discrimination. Evidence for the SC-SB-001 child invariant COLLECTIVE INPUT / STRUCTURAL RESPONSE: uniform collective input, outcome set by whether the target has load-bearing architecture (Vegeta survives, Frieza survives, Kid Buu destroyed). Frieza's architecture is load-bearing though external.
residuals: magnitude confound: the encounters do not separate architecture from energy or circumstance
with films and GT counted, Spirit Bomb kills are Dr. Wheelo, Turles, Lord Slug, Kid Buu and Omega Shenron; survivors are Vegeta, Frieza and Jiren
Frieza's empire and his body durability are different variables
tension with SC-OMNI-001 CLM-OM-002 (Spirit Bomb spares the pure-hearted) is left for Shax

claims.label: INVASIVE-SPECIES SIGNATURE
claims.text: No homeworld, species population or creation myth is shown for Frieza's race; the family that is shown (King Cold) carries the same pattern of conquest without origin. Read as the signature of a lineage that entered from outside rather than evolved here (layer C).
residuals: absence of shown origin is weak evidence: it may be unwritten rather than concealed

claims.label: ENTRY FROM THE OTHER SIDE OF THE MIRROR
claims.text: Within SC-MIRROR-001, Frieza is the entry that comes from the other side of the mirror / horizon: an architecture compiled on a different substrate (SC-HS-001 CLM-HS-002B, OPEN_HYPOTHESIS), running here. Layer D adds a second crossing: the chamber reached from a conquered planet lies outside this universe (Frieza's own words, canon), in the Duality's mirrored universe where time runs in reverse (Shax, OPEN_HYPOTHESIS; Boyle–Finn–Turok model as published anchor).

claims.label: SCALE MAPPINGS
claims.text: AI: a novel architecture trained on different data, then fine-tuned on the target domain, beats the incumbent state of the art. Human: an outsider masters a system the insiders built. Societal: a cross-industry entrant disrupts a legacy market. Cosmological: an entity from another black hole, time dilation, return. These are analogies and do not license dropping layers A–C.

Speaker [Shax/Curtis Kingsley] asserts [STRUCTURAL_ANALOGY, OPEN_HYPOTHESIS, CANON].
Source frame: Dragon Ball (Frieza; DBS manga ch. 87; Black Frieza).
Key elements: external black-hole origin, owning entity, concealed entry, time chamber outside this universe (canon) in the Duality's mirrored universe (interpretation), hierarchy-breaking return, Spirit Bomb survival.
outputs.public_translation: This lineup entry decodes Frieza as an outsider: a lineage that may come from a black-hole domain outside this universe, owned by another entity, that entered by stealth. Its canon anchor is ten years in a time chamber that, by Frieza's own account, kept him outside a universe-wide wish (Shax places it in the Duality's mirrored universe, where time runs in reverse), and the return as Black Frieza, who defeats the two strongest local fighters. It proposes 'substrate activation' — an untrained foreign architecture meeting its first compatible input — as a third power mechanism.
